evidence_quotes.agenda: No quid pro quo framing or agenda question — jumped straight into zip-code/availability lookup for an urgent same/next-day move.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer never raised a discovery concern (only urgency/impatience: 'I just need a price', 'I already explained the pricing I get it, we're good') — scored N/A/full-credit; not counted as a Stage-1 concern.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'this estimate amount right now is $1,824 but of course it's just an estimate, you only pay for the actual time used' — the only Save Your Ass element delivered; no rate-lock/100k line, no explicit 'beats it, pay less,' no self-prep tip, no 'does that feel fair' ask.

top_strength: Stayed accurate on pricing math (hourly rate + transportation fee) despite an impatient customer repeatedly cutting the explanation short.
coaching_note: The damage-coverage, Meet-Your-Mover, and On-Time/Communication differentiators were never delivered at all — the customer's repeated 'I get it, let's just book' should not have been allowed to skip Sheets 1-4 entirely.
